sourceTitle: Ireland Under Coercion: The Diary of an American (1 of 2) (2nd ed.) (1888)
description: "Ireland Under Coercion: The Diary of an American" by William Henry Hurlbert is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work presents a detailed narrative of Hurlbert's observations and conversations gathered during his travels in Ireland between January and June 1888, aiming to explore the complex socio-political landscape of the time.
